Package com.mriss.dsh.restapi.service

Class DocumentSubmissionServiceImplTest

java.lang.Object
com.mriss.dsh.restapi.service.DocumentSubmissionServiceImplTest
public class DocumentSubmissionServiceImplTest extends Object
Unit tests for DocumentSubmissionServiceImpl.

Both MongoDB (DocumentDao) and RabbitMQ (DocumentQueueService) are mocked. The RabbitMQ mock simulates an ACK by invoking the real DocumentEnqueueResponseMessageHandler so that document status transitions are still exercised for coverage.
